name: musescore-viewer
description: Copland MuseScore viewer with NL command bar and seeded scores

scripts.agent: cd agent && (test -d .venv || python3 -m venv .venv) && .venv/bin/pip install -q -r requirements.txt && .venv/bin/python -m copland_agent
scripts.agent:dev: cd agent && (test -d .venv || python3 -m venv .venv) && .venv/bin/pip install -q -r requirements.txt && COPLAND_AGENT_RELOAD=1 .venv/bin/python -m copland_agent
